requirements.title: CURRENT_TEAM is a default integer scalar named constant
requirements.source: S16.10.2.8 p1 constant form; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF473.
requirements.definition: CURRENT_TEAM is a default integer scalar constant in ISO_FORTRAN_ENV.

requirements.title: CURRENT_TEAM identifies the current team for GET_TEAM LEVEL
requirements.source: S16.10.2.8 p1 team identity; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF473.
